history.content: Compare Sedition and Sequestration for me.
Sedition can pressure an opposing Asset; Sequestration can reduce how many Assets remain in play.

cases.question: Can I use that ability now?

history.content: Remind me how Rally and Rout differ for the General.
Rally modifies a battle you initiated before dice. Rout moves you after you win as attacker at the end of Aftermath.

history.content: I'm comparing Sleeper Network and Extraordinary Rendition as banked Assets.
